messages:
Eli Park: Hi all  first day, quick weird one. My laptop and dock arrived but the monitor shows as 'delivered to building security' in the tracker, and security says they never scanned it in. Also when I try to join the office Wi-Fi I get an 802.1x certificate prompt that says 'authentication failed'. Who's the right person to sort both? :wave:

Security Desk: Hi Eli, we only scanned packages that were handed to us. Can you share the tracking number? We can check camera footage but that takes a day.

Eli Park: Tracking RDW-660211 per the onboarding page. It shows POD image of a box at the loading dock, timestamp 08:42. I'm at my desk and need the monitor to set up.

Logistics Bot: Update for RDW-660211: status=delivered, proof_of_delivery=photo_available, delivered_to=loading_dock, courier_notes="left at loading area - no recipient present". To request relocation to reception, reply with "RELOCATE_TO_RECEPTION".

People Ops - Dana: @Eli I can ask Security to fetch it from the loading dock if you want. If it's faster Facilities can bring a spare monitor to your desk.

IT - Sasha: Welcome Eli! For the Wi-Fi 802.1x error: are you getting the macOS certificate dialog asking to trust a CA, or is it a username/password failure? Quick check: System Settings > Network > Wi-Fi > Advanced > Profiles should show "Redwood Network Profile". If profile missing, MDM didn't apply it. Run: `profiles status -type configuration` to see installed profiles.

Eli Park: The dialog asked to verify a certificate chain and then failed. Profiles command returns: "No profiles found."

IT - Sasha: That confirms the profile didn't install. Two options: 1) Re-run the Company Portal enrollment (top-right of the Company Portal app > Re-enroll) which will reinstall the Wi-Fi profile. 2) I can push the profile from the console once I have your serial. Can you DM me the serial or open an IT ticket with the serial?

Eli Park: DM sent with serial. If you can push it that'd be great, I'm at SF HQ and would love to get on network.

Facilities - Marco: I can grab the monitor from the loading dock and bring it to reception. If Logistics approves relocation, I'll place it on the reception desk.

Logistics Bot: RELOCATE_TO_RECEPTION received for RDW-660211. Action: courier recall requested; Facilities pickup approved. ETA for transfer to reception: 90 minutes.

IT - Sasha: Pushed Wi-Fi profile to device; should appear under Profiles in System Settings. After install, forget the Wi-Fi SSID and rejoin. If you still see the cert prompt, accept and choose "Always trust for this network".

Eli Park: Profile appeared, rejoined Wi-Fi, and now I'm online 44d. Thanks Sasha!

Security Desk: FYI Facilities picked up the box and moved it to reception at 09:55.

Eli Park: Got the monitor from reception! Booted fine after switching the DP cable. Opening a ticket per IT request: IT-40988 "Wi-Fi profile missing on new hire device". Thanks everyone for the quick help :smile:
